note: Every value is computed by the committed code from a seeded simulation; nothing is typed in. Cohort: N=1000 digital twins (sepsis 400 / ARDS 350 / ACS 250), simulated WITHOUT any treatment over 24 h; the label is a simulated adverse outcome (Bernoulli draw from p(death) = logistic link of the terminal latent damage). Split 60/20/20 (train/calibration/test). Disease-disjoint features are imputed with training-split medians; the degraded regime uses training-split medians and SDs. Families: LR / RF / GB / XGBoost on the presentation state; LSTM / TCN on the first 12 h. Also written: oracle_metrics.csv (the simulator's own p(death) as a predictor), recalibration.csv (Platt / isotonic fitted on the calibration split), conformal.csv (marginal and Mondrian sets calibrated on clean data, tested on clean and degraded data), nns.csv (alert burden at p_t = 0.30), noise and masking sweeps, the antibiotic-delay sweep and counterfactual alignment (common random numbers). The NNT and synthetic-group fairness outputs of earlier versions were removed in v1.4.0. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
